title: Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency
abstract: arXiv:2611.23198v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trajectory prediction models for automated driving are usually trained on data with a fixed sampling frequency, while positions received via vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication arrive at 1-10 Hz. We study whether a learned predictor that uses only the observation history keeps its advantage over constant velocity (CV) and constant acceleration (CA) models when the history frequency drops. On the Argoverse 2 motion forecasting dataset, the 5 s history of the focal agent was downsampled from 10 Hz to 5, 2, and 1 Hz, and the 6 s future was predicted without maps or neighboring agents. An LSTM-based recurrent neural network (RNN) trained for each frequency was compared with the same network trained at 10 Hz and applied to sparse histories after linear interpolation. translated_title: 降低观测频率下学习型与运动学轨迹预测的对比研究
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶的轨迹预测模型通常使用固定采样频率的数据进行训练，而通过车联网（V2X）通信接收到的位置信息到达频率仅为1-10 Hz。我们研究当历史观测频率降低时，仅使用观测历史的学习型预测器是否仍能保持相对于恒定速度（CV）和恒定加速度（CA）模型的优势。在Argoverse 2运动预测数据集上，将目标智能体的5秒历史数据从10 Hz降采样至5、2和1 Hz，并在不使用地图或相邻智能体信息的情况下预测6秒的未来轨迹。针对每个频率分别训练基于LSTM的循环神经网络（RNN），并与在10 Hz下训练的同一网络（经线性插值后应用于稀疏历史数据）进行比较。假设和阈值在训练前预先固定，主要RNN各使用十个随机种子进行训练，在24,984个测试场景上的结果均带有自助法置信区间。
tldr: 该研究在Argoverse 2数据集上通过将观测历史从10 Hz降采样至1-5 Hz并进行严格的统计检验，系统评估了学习型轨迹预测器相对于恒定速度/加速度运动学模型的优势如何随观测频率降低而变化。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates how the advantage of learned trajectory predictors over constant velocity/acceleration kinematic models changes as observation history is downsampled from 10 Hz to 1-5 Hz on the Argoverse 2 dataset, using rigorous statistical testing.
